reports.title: The Ceasefire Is Already Dead, It Just Has Not Fallen Over Yet
reports.subtitle: Trump called Iran's peace proposal 'garbage,' Hormuz shipping is at 5% of normal, and both sides are now managing a controlled freeze rather than moving toward resolution.

reports.title: The Supreme Court Reversed Itself to Erase a District It Had Previously Ordered to Exist
reports.subtitle: The 6-3 Alabama ruling does not just weaken the Voting Rights Act -- it retroactively rewrites what courts can require states to undo.

reports.title: Trump's Tariff Playbook Has One Move Left and It Also Got Struck Down
reports.subtitle: The Section 122 tariffs are the third legal theory Trump has tried to impose global duties -- and courts keep stopping each one while letting him keep collecting until further notice.

reports.title: Inflation Just Crossed Above the Fed's Policy Rate for the First Time in Three Years
reports.subtitle: April CPI at 3.78% now exceeds the 3.64% Fed funds rate, turning real policy rates negative -- and the Fed's incoming chair has signaled no urgency to respond.

reports.title: Spain Is Moving to Ban Teenagers from Social Media While Making Executives Personally Liable for Hate Speech
reports.subtitle: Madrid is advancing the most aggressive digital regulation in Europe, personally targeting platform leadership at a moment when Elon Musk is fighting back.

reports.title: Musk Says Altman Stole a Charity. The Market Says Musk Wins 30% of the Time.
reports.subtitle: Week three of the OpenAI trial has Altman on the stand denying he betrayed the founding mission -- and Polymarket pricing his opponent as a long shot with real upside.

reports.title: Trump Flies to Beijing Saying He Does Not Need Xi's Help -- Which Is How You Ask for Help
reports.subtitle: The US needs China to pressure Iran. China knows this. Markets put a 16% chance China actually joins Iran negotiations -- and an 88% chance it buys Boeing planes instead.

reports.title: 41,000 Samsung Workers Are About to Strike Over a Bonus Gap That SK Hynix Created
reports.subtitle: South Korea's semiconductor giant lost $66 billion in market value in hours before Seoul intervened -- and the actual dispute is not about wages, it is about who owns the upside of a chip boom.

reports.title: Meta Is Giving Rival AI Chatbots Free WhatsApp Access for One Month to Avoid a Fine It Cannot Afford Politically
reports.subtitle: The EU's DMA is forcing Meta to open the messaging platform it spent years locking down -- but a one-month free trial is not interoperability, it is a negotiating tactic.

reports.title: Trump Wants to Suspend the Gas Tax. The Industry That Runs on Gas Does Not.
reports.subtitle: Gas is up 50% since the Iran war started. An 18-cent relief would cost the highway fund $30 billion and the trucking lobby is already fighting it.

reports.title: The US Is Trying to Cut Off ASML from China While Its President Is in Beijing Asking China for Favors
reports.subtitle: The MATCH Act gives the Netherlands a 150-day deadline to stop ASML sales to China -- and The Hague is openly refusing, catching Washington in a contradiction it cannot resolve.

reports.title: The Senate Has Voted Seven Times to End the Iran War and Lost Every Time. That Is Now the Point.
reports.subtitle: Murkowski flipped, the vote failed 50-49, and Democrats are not trying to stop the war anymore -- they are trying to force Republicans to own it before November.

reports.title: The Senate Is About to Draw the Map of Crypto. The Industry Does Not Know If It Will Like It.
reports.subtitle: The 309-page CLARITY Act goes to Senate Banking Committee markup on May 14 -- it splits crypto between the SEC and CFTC, bans stablecoin yield, and Polymarket gives it 58% odds of becoming law this year.

reports.title: China Did Not Fight in the Iran War. It May Have Won It Anyway.
reports.subtitle: The CFR and Times of India both say the same thing: Beijing watched the US burn through stockpiles, studied its weaknesses, and walked into the Trump summit holding a much stronger Taiwan hand than it had before the war started.

reports.title: The World Is Losing the Health Gains It Spent Twenty Years Building. The WHO Cannot Say Why.
reports.subtitle: The 2026 World Health Statistics report released today says malaria is rising, maternal mortality is stalling, and childhood vaccine coverage is slipping below herd immunity thresholds -- but the report conspicuously avoids naming the funding cuts causing it.
